text:
Go to Tibet.

Ride a camel.

Read the Bible.

Dye your shoes blue.

Grow a beard.

Sail around the world in a

Paper canoe.

Subscribe to the
Saturday Evening


Post
.

Chew only on the left side

Of your mouth.

Marry a woman with

One leg and shave with a

Razor.

And carve your names into her

Arm.

Brush your teeth with gasoline.

Sleep all day and climb the

Trees at night.

Be monks and drink buckshot and

Beer.

Keep your head underwater and

Play the violin.

Do the belly dance before

Pink candles.

Kill your dog.

Introduce yourselves to the mayor.

Live in a barrel.

Split your heads with an axe.

Plant tulips in the rain.

But do not write poetry.

translation.title: Friendly Advice to a Bunch of Young People
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the supplied Spanish version of Charles Bukowski. Odd capitalization, the split “Saturday Evening / Post” wording, punctuation, and lineation are retained as supplied.
